description: Arc-shared record backing (span into raw_json): parse drops ~7%, official 1.196M (1.13-1.25M) — best honest reading.

asi.change: RecordValue now stores a span into a shared Arc<str> backing (the message's raw_json wire buffer) instead of a duplicate Box<str> copy of the record sub-range. raw_json field: Option<Box<str>> -> Option<Arc<str>>. Parse eliminates 1 alloc + 180B copy per message; RecordValue::clone becomes a refcount bump (cheaper production clones). from_span constructor for the parse path; from_raw/from_value/raw()/value() APIs unchanged.
asi.environment: Load 5.2-5.6 — official 11-run median 1.196M (1.132M-1.253M); 20-run median 1.188M (p25 1.161M, p75 1.243M, max 1.270M).
asi.hypothesis: Eliminate the duplicate record-bytes copy in parse: share one Arc<str> backing between message.raw_json and RecordValue via a byte span.
asi.results: Phase probe: parse 3.40->3.16ms, hydrate 3.33->3.21ms, total 7.85->7.54ms (~+4-6%). Official 1.196M vs prior steady state ~1.05-1.13M at similar load — real step up. Tests 216 pass, clippy+fmt clean, bench untouched.

description: Lazy cid (span-into-wire, like RecordValue): parse -0.2ms A/B-confirmed; official 1.272M with 1.402M max.

asi.change: Lazy cid: CommitData.cid: Option<String> -> Option<CidValue> (span into the shared raw_json Arc, like RecordValue). Fast parsers now return the cid byte span (3-tuple); parse_message wires it; tape path fills cid via the derive (CidValue implements Deserialize from string, owned buffer — no new scanner needed). From<String>/From<&str> + PartialEq (by content) + Serialize (serialize_str) for programmatic messages. Only recovery + tests read cid. ~12 type-adaptive construction sites; benches changed only mechanically (values identical).
asi.environment: Load ~5.8 — official 11-run median 1.272M (1.180M-1.402M; max 1.402M new high); A/B probe at same load: parse 2.44-2.63 vs baseline 2.64-2.79, total 6.26-6.78 vs 6.67-6.96 (~0.2ms parse gain).
asi.hypothesis: Eliminate the last per-message heap String in parse (cid, ~58B, read only in recovery) via a span-into-wire type.
asi.results: Parse -0.2ms confirmed by controlled A/B; official at top of steady-state range. 216 tests pass, clippy+fmt clean.
